Lessons.Title: Decimals on Number Lines
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goal: You will reason about and compare the size of decimals using a number line.
Key idea: Decimal number lines locate values by their place values, and a number to the right is greater on the same scale.
How to reason: Align tenths and hundredths accurately to positions between labelled endpoints, then compare values.
Source-inspired opening: Warm-up:  Which One Doesn’t Belong: Decimals and Fractions	 (10 minutes). Use the teacher-provided mathematical representations and explain how different valid answers arise.

Activity 1:  Points on Number Lines	 (20 minutes): apply the learning goal to quantities such as 0.10, 0.40, 0.80, 1.10. First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.

Activity 2:  Decimals Compared	 (15 minutes): apply the learning goal to quantities such as Is the decimal at point A less than or greater than 0.50?
